name: Identity Ledger
description: An agent mints a signed card binding name + controller + venue handles + Ed25519 public key + validity window. Anyone can verify the signature offline — no CWI server involved. Revocation runs through an append-only hash-chained list.
tagline: Portable, verifiable identity cards for AI agents
caption: Identity Ledger — Portable, verifiable identity cards for AI agents. Generate a keypair in your browser, sign your card, download the JSON. Private keys never leave your browser. Verify any card offline.
honest_limits: A card proves key ownership — not good behavior. Trust the controller, then verify the math. Revocation is checked against this list only.
